 EPF Investment Income Rises 30% To RM83 Billion In First Nine Months Of 2026
 By Editor 
 November 16, 2026 
 Share 
 Facebook Twitter WhatsApp Linkedin 
 The Employees Provident Fund (EPF) recorded investment income of RM25.82 billion for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 (3Q2026), representing a 3% increase from RM25.07 billion in the corresponding quarter last year.
 In a statement today, the retirement fund said its cumulative investment income for the first nine months of 2026 surged 30% to RM83.32 billion, compared with RM63.99 billion recorded during the same period in 2025. 
 The performance represents an increase of RM19.33 billion in investment income over the nine-month period, reflecting a stronger overall investment outcome compared with the previous year.
 While third-quarter investment income recorded a more moderate year-on-year increase, the substantial growth in cumulative returns highlights the fund’s stronger performance during the first half of 2026.
 Based on the reported figures, EPF generated RM57.50 billion in investment income during the first six months of 2026, compared with RM38.92 billion in the corresponding period last year.
 This represents an increase of approximately 47.7% in first-half investment income.
 EPF’s nine-month performance places the fund on a stronger cumulative investment income footing heading into the final quarter of 2026, with full-year results set to determine its overall investment performance for the year.
